message: Thanks, that sets the scene. What did you do yourself to get the migration back on track?

parts.text: The team was moving checkout to a new payments provider, and the rollout was two weeks late.
quotes: we were moving checkout to the new payments provider
the rollout was already two weeks late

parts.text: Black Friday was a month away, so a broken checkout would have cost real sales.
quotes: Black Friday was a month out and checkout could not break
